text.name: fp_help_a1_1_text
text.text: FarmPilot drives your vehicles on a road network that you draw on the map. It goes to a destination, loads, delivers, unloads combines and forage harvesters, and in Autonomous mode it chains the fields by itself with Courseplay: fetch the implement, refill, work the field, move on to the next one, put the implement away and park the tractor.

text.name: fp_help_a1_2_text
text.text: FarmPilot is based on AutoDrive 3.0.1.4 (Stephan Schlosser and the AutoDrive team, MIT licence). If you already play with AutoDrive, just replace the mod: FarmPilot takes over your road network (AutoDrive_config.xml), your saved routes, your colours and your vehicle settings. Nothing to copy. If AutoDrive is also active, FarmPilot switches it off and shows a message: remove it from your mods. The former AutoDrive Addon is built in: deactivate FS25_AutoDriveAddon.

text.name: fp_help_a1_3_text
text.text: 1. Draw your roads (category « Route editor ») or load an existing network. 2. Create destinations: fields, silos, selling points, parking places. 3. Get into a vehicle, open the HUD, choose the mode and the destination, then Start.

text.name: fp_help_a2_1_title
text.text: Open the HUD and the mouse

text.name: fp_help_a2_1_text
text.text: Alt + 0 (numpad) shows or hides the HUD. Middle click: the mouse appears so you can click in the HUD (middle click again to hide it). Move the HUD by dragging its top bar. Its size is set in Settings > User > « Gui scale for FarmPilot HUD ».

text.name: fp_help_a2_2_text
text.text: 1. Top bar: vehicle name, close, extended info. 2. List rows: destination, unloading, product, and depending on the mode the rows Trailer, Implement, Next field, Next implement. 3. Buttons left of the rows: automatic choice, settings cogs. 4. Button row: Start/Stop, Mode, Continue (>>), Park (P), loop counter, speed, editor. 5. 2nd row (depending on settings): start Courseplay/helper at the destination, quick settings, settings. 6. Status line: what the driver is doing and for how long.

text.name: fp_help_a2_3_text
text.text: Hover a button with the mouse: its tooltip appears at the very top of the HUD, above the mode (example: « Park vehicle - GT_4 » on the P button). Turn them off in Settings > User > « Show tooltips ».

text.name: fp_help_a3_1_text
text.text: Starts or stops the FarmPilot driver of the vehicle. A started vehicle carries on without you: you can get out or switch vehicles.

text.name: fp_help_a3_2_text
text.text: Left click: next mode. Right click: previous mode. The modes: Drive, Deliver, Pickup and Deliver, Load, Unload Combine, Unload bunker silo, Autonomous. The HUD rows change with the mode.

text.name: fp_help_a3_3_text
text.text: Makes a waiting driver move on (at loading, at refilling, in front of a machine). In Autonomous mode it has extra roles: see « The >> button in Autonomous ».

text.name: fp_help_a3_4_text
text.text: Left click: sends the vehicle to its parking place. If it has an implement or a trailer with its own place, the implement is put at its place first, then the tractor goes to its own. Right click: the destination of the 1st row becomes the parking place (of the tractor, or of the selected implement). See « Parking ».

text.name: fp_help_a3_5_text
text.text: Number of rounds in Pickup and Deliver: 0 = endless. Left click +1, right click -1.

text.name: fp_help_a3_6_text
text.text: Maximum road speed of the vehicle. Mouse wheel on the counter, or the « Increase / Decrease speed » keys.

text.name: fp_help_a3_7_text
text.text: Left click: turns the route editor on. Right click: only shows the roads and the points. See the category « Route editor ».

text.name: fp_help_a3_8_text
text.text: On: on arrival, the helper takes over with the course already loaded in the vehicle. Right click: chooses the helper (Courseplay, AIVE or the game worker). In Autonomous mode this button becomes « Autonomous courses ».

text.name: fp_help_a4_1_text
text.text: Click a row: the list opens, with the destination folders. Click a folder to open it, click a destination to take it. Right click on an Autonomous row (Implement, Next field, Next implement) or on the Trailer row: back to the default value. On the map (M), right click on a FarmPilot marker: it becomes the destination (setting « Switch to markers »).

text.name: fp_help_a4_2_text
text.text: The buttons left of the loading and unloading rows make FarmPilot pick the best loading or selling point for the product. The button left of the product: « Load by fill level ».

text.name: fp_help_a4_3_text
text.text: A cog appears left of a row when the implement or the trailer has settings: seeder, spreader or sprayer, bale loader, trailer swap. Orange = to be set (start refused with a message). Green = validated. One click opens the settings window.

text.name: fp_help_a5_1_text
text.text: - Alt + 0 (numpad): show / hide the HUD - Middle click: show / hide the mouse - Ctrl + Alt + 0 (numpad): FarmPilot settings - Ctrl + Alt + right / left arrow: next / previous destination - Ctrl + Alt + O / Ctrl + Alt + 4 (numpad): next / previous product - Ctrl + Alt + 5 (numpad): Autonomous courses window - Ctrl + Alt + 1 (numpad): routes manager - Ctrl + Alt + M: message history - Shift + C / Shift + V: copy / paste the settings from one vehicle to another - Ctrl + Shift + F: create the field points

text.name: fp_help_a5_2_text
text.text: All FarmPilot actions are in Options > Controls, named « FP - … »: activate, change mode, continue, park, set the parking place, refuel, repair, call a driver, enter the arrived vehicle, name the driver, destination filter, swap destinations, road and field speed, repetitions, all the editor keys. Many have no default key: assign them yourself.

text.name: fp_help_a6_1_text
text.text: Each stop, wait or refused start shows a message with the reason (« seeder settings to validate », « no next field set », « the implement is attached to another vehicle »…). Their duration is set in Settings > User > « Notifications ».

text.name: fp_help_a6_2_text
text.text: Ctrl + Alt + M opens the « Notifications » window: find what happened while you were elsewhere. Backspace deletes the selected message, Space deletes all, Esc closes.

text.name: fp_help_a6_3_text
text.text: Under the HUD and on the map, each driver says what it is doing and for how long: « Parking in the field », « Following the forage harvester from behind », « Calculating the path (12 s) », « Letting pass »…

text.name: fp_help_b1_1_text
text.text: Choose a destination, then Start. The vehicle follows the network to the destination, then stops.

text.name: fp_help_b1_2_text
text.text: Turn on « Start at destination » (2nd row): on arrival, Courseplay, AIVE or the game worker takes over with the course already loaded in the vehicle. To let FarmPilot choose the Courseplay course itself and chain the fields, use Autonomous mode.

text.name: fp_help_b2_1_text
text.text: Choose the unloading point, then Start. The vehicle goes there, empties its trailer (tipping side chosen by itself, cover opened then closed), then parks if « Park at Job finished » is on Yes and a place is set, otherwise it stops. (Screen Update coming)

text.name: fp_help_b3_1_text
text.text: 1st row: loading point. 2nd row: unloading point. 3rd row: product. The vehicle loads, delivers, then starts again. (Screen Update coming)

text.name: fp_help_b3_2_text
text.text: Loop counter: 0 = endless, otherwise number of rounds before stopping (then it parks if that is set). The buttons left of the rows automatically pick the best loading or selling point.

text.name: fp_help_b3_3_text
text.text: Vehicle setting « Cycle Pickup and Deliver »: FarmPilot takes in turn the pickup and/or delivery points of the same folder.

text.name: fp_help_b3_4_text
text.text: Vehicle setting « Loading stopped: leave after »: if the trailer already holds something and nothing more comes in, it leaves after 15 s, 30 s (default), 1, 2 or 5 min. « No »: it waits to be full up to the « Unload fill level » (the right choice for a truck at the field edge). A rest under 1 % counts as an empty trailer.

text.name: fp_help_b4_1_text
text.text: The vehicle loads at the point of the 2nd row (product of the 3rd row), then drives to the point of the 1st row and stops. Handy to fill a machine before going to the field. Seeders, spreaders and sprayers in Autonomous mode refill by themselves (see category C).

text.name: fp_help_b5_1_text
text.text: 1st row: the field. 2nd row: where to deliver. The tractor waits near the field, comes under the pipe when the combine calls it, follows it while it unloads, then delivers and comes back. (Screen Update coming)

text.name: fp_help_b5_2_text
text.text: As long as the combine unloads into its trailer and the trailer is not full, the tractor does not reverse and does not leave: it stays stopped if the combine stops, moves with it, and only reverses if the combine reverses. It leaves when the trailer is full, the pipe is folded, or nothing has come in for 3 s.

text.name: fp_help_b5_3_text
text.text: While waiting for the call, the trailer enters the field and parks along the edge, on already harvested ground, flat, at least 40 m from the entrance, on the side where the machine is working. The next trailers park in a queue behind it. The place is kept for the field. Field full: the trailer waits at the roadside before the entrance. Setting « Wait inside the field » (Yes by default).

text.name: fp_help_b5_4_text
text.text: The trailer refuses a line that would take it into the standing crop (crop block between 2 and 10 m ahead). The path to the place never goes through the crop.

text.name: fp_help_b5_5_text
text.text: When the combine has finished its field, its trailers go and unload what they carry, then return to their parking place.

text.name: fp_help_b5_6_text
text.text: Settings > Unload combine: early call (fill level that calls the driver), call the 2nd driver, unloading on the move, forage harvester unloading side. Vehicle settings: pipe offset, distance behind the combine, unload fill level, park in field.

text.name: fp_help_b6_1_text
text.text: With a forage harvester, the trailer aims for the place behind the machine, on its cut track, then takes the free side. It reads the Courseplay course ahead of the forage harvester (end of row, U-turn) and keeps its place while the harvester turns.

text.name: fp_help_b6_2_title
text.text: U-turns at the end of the row

text.name: fp_help_b6_2_text
text.text: The trailer chooses its manoeuvre depending on the space: forward U-turn, reverse then U-turn, offset U-turn, Y-turn when the headland is narrow, square turn, or U-turn in the cut strip. Each manoeuvre is checked beforehand (field ground, crop, obstacles), at the tractor's turning radius.

text.name: fp_help_b6_3_text
text.text: The 2nd trailer follows the tracks of the 1st and waits behind it. It moves aside when the harvester or the 1st trailer comes towards it, then comes back into place.

text.name: fp_help_b6_4_title
text.text: Full trailer and end of the job

text.name: fp_help_b6_4_text
text.text: Full trailer: it leaves through the field entrance; otherwise it reverses in its tracks, pulls aside to let the next one pass, or turns in the strip. End of the job (also seen by Courseplay): each trailer unloads what it carries, then goes to its parking. A short stop of the harvester does not release the trailers.

text.name: fp_help_b7_1_text
text.text: For a bucket loader: it takes from the bunker silo and fills the trailers that come. Vehicle settings: bucket width and height if the detection is not right. The button next to the counter chooses to unload into a trailer or into the biogas plant.

text.name: fp_help_b8_1_text
text.text: In the modes with a trailer (Pickup and Deliver, Load, Deliver, Unload Combine), the 4th row is « Trailer ». Default: « the attached one », nothing changes. Choose a trailer in the list: tippers, flatbeds, tankers and overloaders of the farm, detached, that hitch behind this tractor, the closest first (« name · capacity »). Right click: back to « the attached one ». (Screen Update coming)

text.name: fp_help_b8_2_text
text.text: If the chosen trailer is not attached, the tractor fetches it along your roads up to the front of it, reverses to the drawbar, hitches it (hoses connected with the manual attach mod), then the mode starts. Start refused, with a message, if it is attached to another vehicle, if something else is already attached behind, or if it does not hitch to this tractor.

text.name: fp_help_b8_3_title
text.text: At the end of the job

text.name: fp_help_b8_3_text
text.text: Loop counter finished, or end of the forage harvester job: if the trailer has its parking place and the tractor its own, the trailer is put at its place, then the tractor goes to its own.

text.name: fp_help_b9_1_text
text.text: At delivery, instead of going to unload, the tractor drops the full trailer on a free place and leaves straight away with an empty trailer. Available in Pickup and Deliver and in Unload Combine: cog left of the « Trailer » row.

text.name: fp_help_b9_2_text
text.text: Create a destination folder and put one marker per place in it (at least 4.5 m between two places side by side). The tractor drives to the marker and stops on it, the trailer stays behind it. A place is free when nothing is on the road leading to the marker (22 m on the trailer side, 10 m on the other). Leave room in front of the empty trailers so it can get in front of the drawbar and reverse. Put at least one empty trailer and leave at least one place free. (Screen Update coming)

text.name: fp_help_b9_3_text
text.text: Click the cog: « Trailer swap » window. 1st row « No (normal delivery) », then each folder with its number of places, free places and empty trailers. Choose or double click. Orange = no swap, green = swap set.

text.name: fp_help_b9_4_text
text.text: Full trailer: it goes to the 1st free place, detaches (support leg, hoses), goes and hitches the closest empty trailer (under 1 % filled, that takes the same product), then gets back to work. The empty trailer becomes the trailer of the « Trailer » row. The full trailers stay on the places: empty them yourself or with another vehicle. Two tractors on the same folder never aim for the same place or the same trailer.

text.name: fp_help_b9_5_text
text.text: No free place, no suitable empty trailer, or a train of several trailers: it delivers normally, with a message.

text.name: fp_help_c1_1_title
text.text: The field from A to Z

text.name: fp_help_c1_1_text
text.text: Autonomous mode does all the work of a field: fetch the implement, refill, drive to the field, start Courseplay with the right course, refill along the way, then chain the next field or put the implement away and park the tractor.

text.name: fp_help_c1_2_text
text.text: Courseplay installed, with saved courses for your fields. A working implement: soil cultivation, seeder, planter, sprayer, spreader, mower, tedder, windrower, baler, bale loader… With only a tipper, a flatbed or a combine, the start is refused.

text.name: fp_help_c1_3_text
text.text: General setting « Autonomous without Courseplay »: Wait (default: the driver stops at the field) or Game worker (the game worker takes the field). With Courseplay installed, the game worker is never used.

text.name: fp_help_c2_1_text
text.text: 1. Field: the field to work. 2. Front: the implement or weight to attach at the front (« the attached one » by default). 3. Rear: the implement to attach at the rear (« the attached one » by default). 4. Next field: the field to do next (empty by default). 5. Next front: the front implement of the next field. 6. Next rear: the rear implement of the next field (« the same » by default). Right click on an implement row or on Next field: back to the default value. The implement cogs are left of their row.

text.name: fp_help_c2_2_text
text.text: The Rear list shows the farm's detached implements that hitch behind this tractor, by function and width: « The attached one » first, then « Cultivator (8 m) », « Planter (8.4 m) »…, sorted by function then width (no width for a bale loader). Two identical implements: the distance is added (« Mower (3.4 m) · 230 m »). The Front list shows « The attached one », the front implements (« Mower (3.4 m) »), then the weights by mass; two identical weights are told apart by their distance (« Weight (1,000 kg) · 72 m »). A front implement is never offered at the rear, and the other way round.

text.name: fp_help_c2_3_text
text.text: The field is the one of the marker number (« Field 56 » = field 56) if it is less than 100 m away; otherwise the one under the tractor on arrival, otherwise the closest. « Field 52 - 53 »: the closest of the two. Fields merged by AutoSwitch count as one.

text.name: fp_help_c3_1_text
text.text: On arrival, FarmPilot takes the saved Courseplay course (all folders) that covers this field and has exactly the implement's width, within 10 cm. It loads it and starts Courseplay at the first waypoint.

text.name: fp_help_c3_2_text
text.text: The chosen course is kept for this field and this implement, whatever the tractor, in the savegame. Weights do not count. The next year, it is reused directly.

text.name: fp_help_c3_3_text
text.text: No course of the right width, or several without a kept choice: the driver stops at the field and a message gives the reason. Choose the course in the Autonomous courses window, then start again.

text.name: fp_help_c3_4_text
text.text: HUD button (in Autonomous, in place of the Courseplay button) or Ctrl + Alt + 5 (numpad), in the vehicle with the implement attached. At the top: the implement and its width. One row per field or group of fields (« Fields 52 + 53 + 54 + 55 »). On the right, the course used: « Automatic: course name » when only one Courseplay course fits, or « Automatic (2 courses: stop) » when there are several: the driver then stops, you have to pick one. Enter (or double click): moves to the next course. Space: back to Automatic. Esc: back.

text.name: fp_help_c4_title
text.text: Fetch the implement, put it back at its place

text.name: fp_help_c4_1_text
text.text: If the Rear row is not « the attached one », the driver takes your roads to the implement's place (or to the network point in front of the implement), lines up in front of it, reverses, hitches it, connects hoses and PTO (manual attach mod), lifts it and leaves for the field. The road of the place is only used if the implement is parked in line with it; otherwise it goes to the network point in front of the drawbar.

text.name: fp_help_c4_2_text
text.text: With an implement on the Front row: if there is a weight at the front, the tractor first drops it at the back of its own parking place (the tractor's), driving in nose first. Another front implement is put at its place, or next to the rear implement. Then it goes in front of the front implement, nose towards it, moves up to the attach point (missed: it reverses and tries again, 2 times at most), then hitches the rear implement as usual. Front + rear mower is not refused.

text.name: fp_help_c4_3_title
text.text: End of the job with a front implement

text.name: fp_help_c4_3_text
text.text: In order: rear implement put at its place, front implement put at its place (or next to the rear implement, parallel, 1 m between them), weight taken back at the tractor's place, tractor parked. After each detach at the front, it reverses 8 m straight.

text.name: fp_help_c4_4_text
text.text: No path up to the front of the implement: it moves forward (or reverses) 10 m straight then recalculates, 2 times at most, before stopping with a message. Leave room in front of parked implements.

text.name: fp_help_c4_5_text
text.text: End of the job with no next field: if the implement has its parking place and the tractor its own (different), the driver puts the implement at its place, turns it off, disconnects PTO and hoses, detaches it, then goes and parks the tractor. Weights ignored. Several implements attached, or implement without a place: it parks as before, with the implement.

text.name: fp_help_c4_6_text
text.text: At the start, FarmPilot waits until folding, attaching or a game order is finished. A blocked fold is restarted towards the transport position (implement lifted first). A message shows every minute while it waits.

text.name: fp_help_c5_1_text
text.text: Next field row. Choose a field in the list, or right click on the map. When the current field is finished, the next field moves to the 1st row, the row empties, and the driver leaves to work it. Empty: it puts the implement away and parks. (Screen Update coming)

text.name: fp_help_c5_2_text
text.text: Next front and Next rear rows, only useful with a next field. At the end of the field: it puts the attached implements at their place, fetches the next implements, then leaves for the next field. The next implements then move to the Front and Rear rows.

text.name: fp_help_c5_3_text
text.text: Next implement attached to another vehicle, or that does not hitch to this tractor: the attached implement is still put at its place, then the driver stops with a message. Start again when the implement is free. Attached implement without a parking place, or several implements: stop at the end of the field with a message.

text.name: fp_help_c5_4_text
text.text: On the road to the field, >> skips this field and leaves for the next field, with the same steps as a finished field (next implement, refill). At the field, >> does nothing: Courseplay finishes the field. Without a next field: message « no next field set ». During a refill, a hitching or a drop: no skip.

text.name: fp_help_c6_1_text
text.text: With a seeder on the Rear row (or Next rear), a cog appears. Orange: start refused (« seeder settings to validate »). It opens the « Seeder settings » window: - Crop to sow: only those this seeder can sow this season (game calendar); a crop saved out of season shows « (out of season) ». - Load: Seeds, Load: Solid fertilizer… Yes or No for each (Enter changes the value). - Refill point: your markers less than 50 m from a place that has the product (station, silo, shop, big bags, pallets). None: all are shown. - Validate (Space key). Then the window shows « Settings validated: start allowed. » and the cog turns green. Esc closes without validating. The setting is kept per field and per seeder; on a new field, the window takes the seeder's last settings.

text.name: fp_help_c6_2_text
text.text: At the start, once the seeder is attached, the crop is set on the seeder. If the chosen tanks are not full, it goes to refill at the point, then leaves for the field. Empty seeder at the field: Courseplay stops, the driver leaves the field, refills, comes back, and Courseplay restarts at the last waypoint. It waits until the tanks are full; >> makes it leave without waiting.

text.name: fp_help_c6_3_text
text.text: FarmPilot sets Courseplay for you: « refill in the field » off, seeder fertilizer on only if you load fertilizer.

text.name: fp_help_c7_1_text
text.text: Trailed or self-propelled. Cog on the machine's row, « Spreader settings » window: - Product to load (those the tank accepts). - Quantity to take: Full, or Just enough for the field (rate x area + 10 %, the estimate is shown). - Refill point (markers near a place that has the product). - Validate (Space key). Start refused until it is validated.

text.name: fp_help_c7_2_text
text.text: Refilling works like for the seeder, at the start and when the tank is empty at the field. At the end of the field: same product on the next field with the same machine, the rest is kept. Otherwise the rest is given back to the stock or sold, then the usual steps. Slurry, manure, digestate: the rest also goes back into the pit / the storage, or is sold.

text.name: fp_help_c7_3_text
text.text: Park button on a spreader or sprayer that still holds more than 20 L: it first gets rid of the rest, then parks (implement put at its place if it has one). Point used: the one of the current field, otherwise the last one set for this machine and this product, otherwise the closest marker that has this product.

text.name: fp_help_c8_1_title
text.text: The course that follows the windrows

text.name: fp_help_c8_1_text
text.text: With a baler, FarmPilot does not look for the implement width: it reads the windrows on the ground and takes the field's Courseplay course, whatever its width, that runs best over them (usually the combine's or the windrower's). Courseplay handles the baler as usual (bales, wrapping).

text.name: fp_help_c8_2_text
text.text: If no course has at least 25 % of its waypoints on a windrow: message « baler: no Courseplay course of field X lies on the windrows, waiting ». This happens if the field is already baled, if the straw was chopped, or if the harvest did not follow a saved course. The choice is made again on each arrival.

text.name: fp_help_c9_1_text
text.text: Cog on the loader's row, « Bale loader settings » window: - Bales to collect: All, Wrapped only, Unwrapped only. - Drop-off point: at the top, the markers less than 60 m from a selling point that takes bales (« sale · name »); then all the other markers for storage. - Validate (Space key; refused until a point is chosen).

text.name: fp_help_c9_2_text
text.text: On arrival at the field, FarmPilot looks for the bales the loader can take: round or square, right size, from your farm, on the ground on this field, not stacked, one product at a time. The arm goes to work position, it drives to the closest bale, lines up so the arm passes over it (12 km/h far away, 6 km/h when close) and the game arm picks it up. Missed bale: a 2nd try, then it is left. Bale right in front of the tractor: it reverses 10 m first. (Screen Update coming)

text.name: fp_help_c9_3_text
text.text: Full loader: arm in, road to the drop-off point, automatic unloading, back to the field if bales are left. At a selling point the bales are sold; at a storage point they are put down at the marker. No more bales: last drop-off, then next field or parking.

text.name: fp_help_c9_4_title
text.text: The >> button with the bale loader

text.name: fp_help_c9_4_text
text.text: With bales loaded: drop-off straight away, then back to the field. Empty loader: the field is left, steps of a finished field.

text.name: fp_help_c10_title
text.text: Combine and forage harvester in Autonomous (header)

text.name: fp_help_c10_1_text
text.text: In Autonomous mode, a combine or a forage harvester has 4 rows instead of the implement rows: 1. Field: it is also the field of its trailers. The trailers in « Unload Combine » that have this field serve it, and they change field with it at the next field (unless another combine is still harvesting the old one). 2. Header: « auto » chooses, depending on the field's crop, a farm header that can cut it (grain header, corn header, forage harvester header). You can also choose a specific header. No header for this crop: start refused, with a message. 3. Next field. 4. Next header: « auto » by default; it becomes the Header row on the next field.

text.name: fp_help_c10_2_title
text.text: The tractor of the header trailer

text.name: fp_help_c10_2_text
text.text: The cog of the Header row opens the « Header transport » window. Orange: the nearest free tractor (stopped, nothing attached behind; a weight or a front implement do not matter). Green: the tractor you chose. A tractor already attached to the trailer is always taken first.

text.name: fp_help_c10_3_text
text.text: 1. You start the combine without a header. 2. The tractor hitches the header trailer and brings it towards the field. It stops it at a clear spot on the side where the combine arrives (no standing crop, ditch, water or obstacle); otherwise it looks for another clear spot within 1 km. 3. The combine follows at a distance, stops before the field track and waits until the trailer is in place. The status bar then says « Wait for the other machine ». 4. It attaches the header driving forward, reverses and starts its Courseplay course. The tractor puts the empty trailer at its place, then parks: it is free. 5. Field finished: a tractor brings the trailer back to the field, the combine puts the header on it, then goes to its place. The tractor puts the trailer away.

text.name: fp_help_c10_4_title
text.text: Header without a trailer (corn header on the ground)

text.name: fp_help_c10_4_text
text.text: The combine fetches it alone, without a tractor. To put it back, it goes to the header's parking place if it has one, otherwise where it took it (same spot, same direction). Give a parking place to your headers left on the ground: the remembered spot is lost when the game is reloaded.

text.name: fp_help_c10_5_title
text.text: Header change on the next field

text.name: fp_help_c10_5_text
text.text: Wheat then corn: the grain header goes back on its trailer, then the combine takes the corn header. Corn then wheat: the corn header is put down, then the tractor brings the grain header to the next field.

text.name: fp_help_c10_6_text
text.text: No path to the header: the combine asks the tractor to move the trailer (3 times at most), then both stop with the message « no path to the front of the implement ».

text.name: fp_help_c11_1_text
text.text: Courseplay stops for lack of fuel: FarmPilot leaves the field (if the entrance is more than 30 m away), refuels at the closest pump, comes back, and Courseplay restarts where it stopped. Set « wait for refuel » to No in Courseplay. Field finished with a next field and a tank (diesel or DEF) under 20 %: refuel first.

text.name: fp_help_c11_2_text
text.text: During a refill: leave without waiting. On the road: next field. Bale loader: drop-off or field left. At the field with Courseplay: nothing.

text.name: fp_help_c11_3_text
text.text: - Set a parking place for each implement and each tractor. - Save your Courseplay courses at the exact width of your implements. - Leave room in front of parked implements and trailers. - Check the cogs: orange = start refused.

text.name: fp_help_d1_1_text
text.text: Each vehicle and each implement can have its place. Put the place in the 1st row, then Ctrl + click on the parking button (P): with an implement selected, it is the implement's place; with no implement selected, the tractor's. The tractor's place must be different from the implement's. (Screen Update coming)

text.name: fp_help_d1_2_text
text.text: - Implement place: the road leading to it is drawn in reverse (the tractor reverses the implement into it). - Header place: drawn forward, the marker 5 m before the header.

text.name: fp_help_d1_3_text
text.text: Every implement or trailer attached directly to the tractor that has its place is put at its place first, then the tractor goes to its own. Weights ignored. The button switches to Autonomous for the drop, then the previous mode comes back by itself (tractor parked, stop or error).

text.name: fp_help_d1_4_title
text.text: Park at the end of the job

text.name: fp_help_d1_4_text
text.text: Vehicle setting « Park at Job finished » (Deliver, Pickup and Deliver): at the end, vehicle and implement go to their place.

text.name: fp_help_d2_1_text
text.text: It watches the road ahead and slows down gradually before an obstacle. It follows a slower vehicle at its speed and keeps 3 m behind another FarmPilot vehicle. Behind a vehicle on the weighbridge, with a driver or in a queue, it waits without going around.

text.name: fp_help_d2_2_text
text.text: An obstacle on one side only (post, cone, bale, parked car) is avoided by a slight offset, without stopping, then it comes back onto its line. Posts that are on your road are seen at calculation time: the road passes beside them with the width of the vehicle combination plus 30 cm (except ditch, bank, bridge or walls).

text.name: fp_help_d2_3_text
text.text: Blocked by a fixed object (fallen object, low wall, tree, vehicle stopped for a long time): it reverses then calculates a path to rejoin its road further on. In front of a gate, it waits. Settings: obstacle detour yes/no, delay, reverse before detour.

text.name: fp_help_d2_4_text
text.text: If it should drive but does not move 50 cm in 3 s, it reverses 3 to 5 m and passes beside it, on the free side. If it still pushes, it reverses and calculates a detour.

text.name: fp_help_d2_5_text
text.text: After two failed detours in front of the same fixed object, it creeps forward (2.5 km/h). If it stays stuck, the passage is remembered as blocked for this combination width and wider ones (saved in the game) and it turns back by another road. The next starts avoid this passage. A passage whose points were moved in the editor is forgotten. To forget everything: delete FarmPilot_PassagesBouches.xml from the savegame folder, game closed.

text.name: fp_help_d3_1_text
text.text: Two FarmPilot vehicles about to meet nose to nose are seen from far away (250 m): they slow down and stop at a good distance. One pulls over to the side (place calculated with the size of both combinations, the slope, water and fields), the other passes, or one reverses. The empty vehicle gives way first, then the one without a trailer. A header trailer never reverses.

text.name: fp_help_d3_2_text
text.text: Priority to the one already engaged. The one giving way stops 15 m before the track entrance and waits until the other has passed (plus 10 m). The one that cannot reverse takes another road and comes back later.

text.name: fp_help_d3_3_text
text.text: After two failures, red message and 5-minute pause for the pair. Settings: head-on passing yes/no, delay before passing, max reverse distance, clearance between combinations, driving side (right or left).

text.name: fp_help_d4_1_text
text.text: Mark dangerous crossings as Intersection in the editor (see « Road types »). Before crossing or merging, the vehicle slows down (20 then 8 km/h), checks the lanes over 120 m and stops just before the first red point if a vehicle is coming (traffic, tractor, player). Then it crosses without stopping.

text.name: fp_help_d4_2_text
text.text: The gap it waits for depends on the time the combination needs to cross. After 30 s of waiting, it becomes less demanding. It does not go if the exit is busy. Stopped in the middle: it reverses back to its line.

text.name: fp_help_d5_1_text
text.text: The speed depends on the real radius of the bend, and the tractor brakes before entering it. Example: radius 12 m = 16 km/h, radius 40 m = 30 km/h. Vehicle setting « Corner speed » (50 to 200 %).

text.name: fp_help_d5_2_text
text.text: A bend is first simulated as you drew it: if the combination gets through, it is left alone. Otherwise it is redrawn at the widest line that gets through, at most 3 m from your road, without obstacle and without a wheel off the tarmac.

text.name: fp_help_d5_3_text
text.text: If the last bend before the destination is too tight, FarmPilot plans before leaving a manoeuvre (forward, reverse, forward again), or another arrival through a detour, and keeps the fastest. With a trailed implement, it only reverses straight, 8 m at most.

text.name: fp_help_d5_4_text
text.text: With « Turnlight Automatic », the indicator comes on at the set distance (« Turnlight Distance », 20 to 100 m) before a bend or a junction, and stays on until the tractor is straight again. No indicator for a sidestep. Engine off: it goes off.

text.name: fp_help_d6_1_text
text.text: - Main: the normal road. - Secondary: taken if it saves time, depending on the vehicle type (cog in the general settings). - Tertiary (dirt track): special road, only for the vehicle types allowed in that cog, and never as a shortcut. Limited speed (« Max speed on tertiary roads », 30 km/h by default): the vehicle slows down 30 m before. - Access: only taken to reach the point it leads to (a place, a silo…), never to pass through. - Intersection: the vehicle slows down and looks before crossing.

text.name: fp_help_d6_2_text
text.text: - « Secondary roads »: Auto = by vehicle type (cog: Yes / No per type); Allowed = taken whenever they save time; Never. - « Tertiary roads »: Auto = by vehicle type (cog); Allowed; Never. One choice for all vehicles. Never = taken only if no other road exists, or if the other one is too narrow.

text.name: fp_help_d6_3_text
text.text: The route calculation avoids sections too narrow for the combination (dual wheels, wide implement) when another way exists. The width is measured at the tyres; a folding implement counts as 2.4 m.

text.name: fp_help_d7_1_text
text.text: To leave the field, the vehicle first aims for the entrance of the field it is in, instead of the closest network point (which can be behind the crop or on the neighbouring field). Otherwise it tries up to 6 other points, without crossing the crop or another field. Gates are passed in line: it lines up 12 to 20 m before.

text.name: fp_help_d7_2_text
text.text: « Restrict pathfinder to field » and « Avoid fruit » have a Strict value: the calculation never lifts the restriction, and the trailer never drives on the neighbouring field. Small forgotten crop islands are ignored.

text.name: fp_help_d7_3_text
text.text: A stuck combination (crop around, bend too tight) frees itself with small forward curves. A spot that keeps blocking becomes a no-go zone for 5 minutes.

text.name: fp_help_e1_1_text
text.text: Editor button of the HUD (or key « FP - Activate edit mode »). The roads and points appear around the vehicle and the editing buttons are added to the HUD. Middle click to get the mouse. Right click on the editor button: shows only the roads. Setting « Line height »: lines on the ground or above the tractor. (Screen Update coming)

text.name: fp_help_e1_2_text
text.text: Record, Routes manager, Create destination, Delete a point (right click: delete a destination), Rename the destination.

text.name: fp_help_e2_1_text
text.text: Drive: a point is set regularly behind you. Click again: end of the recording. The type depends on the click: - Left click: one-way. - Right click: two-way. - Shift + left / right click: secondary, one-way / two-way. - Ctrl + left / right click: 2 roads at once (one on each side), one-way / two-way. - Ctrl + Shift + click: 2 roads at once, secondary. Reversing while recording creates a reverse road (to park by reversing). (Screen Update coming)

text.name: fp_help_e2_2_text
text.text: General settings « Auto connect (start) » and « Auto connect (end) »: the start and the end of the recording are linked to the nearby point. User setting « Record without driver »: the recording goes on if you get out.

text.name: fp_help_e3_1_text
text.text: In the editor, mouse active (a reminder shows next to the HUD): - Left click on a point: select it. Left click on a 2nd point: link them, or undo the link. - At the 2nd point, Ctrl + left click: one-way or two-way. - Shift + right click on the 2nd point: reverse line. - Ctrl + left click in empty space: create a point (linked to the selected point). - Alt + left click on a point: delete it. - Shift + left click on a point: change its type (see « Road types and colours »). - Right click (or wheel) held on a point: move it.

text.name: fp_help_e3_2_text
text.text: Point selected then hovering another one: a curve preview appears (green = gets through, red = collision). The click links with the curve.

text.name: fp_help_e4_1_text
text.text: A section = the chain of points between two junctions. Select the 1st point, hover the last one: the section lights up. - Ctrl + click: changes the direction of the whole section (one-way, reversed, two-way). - Shift + click: changes the type of the whole section. - Ctrl + Shift + Alt + click: deletes the whole section.

text.name: fp_help_e4_2_text
text.text: Alt held on a selected point + mouse wheel: enlarges or shrinks the selection area; click: deletes all points in the area.

text.name: fp_help_e5_1_text
text.text: Shift + left click on a point or a section cycles its type (main, secondary, tertiary, access, intersection…). (Screen Update coming)

text.name: fp_help_e5_2_text
text.text: In edit mode, an « Editor reminder » shows next to the HUD with these colours and the commands. - Main: green (one-way), blue (two-way). - Secondary: light orange (one-way), brown (two-way). - Tertiary: pink (one-way), purple (two-way). - Access: orange (one-way), beige (two-way). - Intersection: red. - Reverse: light blue. Colours are changed in Settings > User > « Custom colors ».

text.name: fp_help_e6_1_text
text.text: Put the vehicle where you want it (on a point), « Create destination » button, type the name. Rename: Rename button. Delete: right click on the Delete button. Tip: one clear name per use (« Field 56 », « Farm silo », « G_Seeder 1 » for a parking place). (Screen Update coming)

text.name: fp_help_e6_2_text
text.text: Setting « Use folders »: destinations are sorted into folders (drag and drop in the open list, or via the settings). Folders are also used for the pickup and delivery cycle and for trailer swap. Destination filter: key « FP - Destination filter ».

text.name: fp_help_e6_3_text
text.text: Setting « Show markers »: FarmPilot markers on the menu map and/or the in-game map.

text.name: fp_help_e7_1_text
text.text: Ctrl + Shift + F: creates points along the edge of the fields. Settings: offset (inside or outside the edge) and distance between the points.

text.name: fp_help_e7_2_text
text.text: Ctrl + Alt + 1 (numpad): export your network under a name, or import a saved network (share with a friend, keep a backup before big changes). (Screen Update coming)

text.name: fp_help_f1_1_text
text.text: Ctrl + Alt + 0 (numpad) or HUD button. Tabs: Vehicle (for the vehicle you are in), Unload combine, General (the whole game), User (your display), Environment (lights), Colours, Debug. Each row has a tooltip. Shift + C / Shift + V copy the settings from one vehicle to another.

text.name: fp_help_f2_1_text
text.text: Corner speed, Restrict pathfinder to field (No / Yes / Strict), Avoid fruit (No / Yes / Strict), Maximum trigger distance.

text.name: fp_help_f2_2_text
text.text: Unload fill level (start level), Loading stopped: leave after, Cycle Pickup and Deliver, Automatic Tip Side, Automatic Trailer Covers, Fold implements (Yes when bought), Change tires at (with AutoSwitch, 20 % when bought), Autoload: Unload Position and wait time, Swath detection (No when bought).

text.name: fp_help_f2_3_text
text.text: Pipe Offset, Distance combine, Park in field, Restrict unloader to field.

text.name: fp_help_f2_4_text
text.text: Park at Job finished, Automatic Refueling, Automatic Repairing.

text.name: fp_help_f3_1_text
text.text: Collision detection, Head-on passing (+ delay, max reverse distance, clearance, driving side), Obstacle detour (+ delay, reverse), Maximum detour, Secondary roads and Tertiary roads (+ cog per vehicle type), Max speed on tertiary roads.

text.name: fp_help_f3_2_text
text.text: Wait inside the field, Autonomous without Courseplay, Driver wages, Autostart helpers (at loading), Bunker Silo / Unload Manager Range (vehicles go one at a time).

text.name: fp_help_f3_3_text
text.text: Pathfinder algorithm, Pathfinder factor, Collisionheigth over ground, Use folders, Auto connect (start) and (end), Record offset in driving direction / in opposite driving direction, Fieldpoint Offset, field point max. distance, Maximum trigger distance, Routemanager on Server.

text.name: fp_help_f4_1_text
text.text: Gui scale for FarmPilot HUD, Notifications, Display help (keys in F1), Show next path, Line height, Show tooltips, Show markers (on the map), Switch to markers, Add settings to HUD, Logo personalization, Wide HUD, Sound, Scale Lines, Scale Destination Name, Custom colors, Record without driver.

text.name: fp_help_f4_2_text
text.text: Turnlight Automatic (Yes/No), Turnlight Distance, Engine Stop Delay (Never, 10 s, 30 s, 1, 2 or 5 min), Beacon lights (outside fields), Worklight when Loading / Unloading, Worklight when in a Silo Bunker, Hazard Lights (when reversing), Remaining Drive time (calculation for other mods; increase or turn off if the game slows down).

text.name: fp_help_f5_1_text
text.text: The vehicle centres the whole combination on the bridge, stops 5 s and shows product, load and total weight, then drives on. Stopping by hand 3 s on the bridge: the weight is shown too. With AutoSwitch, each weighing goes into its register. (Screen Update coming)

text.name: fp_help_f5_2_text
text.text: Engine stop after the set delay. Engine off: only the basic lights stay on, everything comes back on restart.

text.name: fp_help_f5_3_text
text.text: At loading, if the trailer already holds something and nothing more comes in, it leaves with what it has, according to « Loading stopped: leave after ».

text.name: fp_help_f5_4_text
text.text: When the game starts, each tractor selects the implement attached behind it.

text.name: fp_help_f6_1_text
text.text: With « Automatic Refueling / Repairing », the vehicle goes to the closest pump or workshop linked to the network, but only after the current job (trailer emptied, combine served). Never postponed: your request, Courseplay's request, a tank under 5 % or 90 % damage.

text.name: fp_help_f7_1_text
text.text: - Courseplay: Autonomous mode courses, forage harvester, right click left to the FarmPilot HUD and editor. - AIVE and game worker: helper at the destination. - AutoSwitch: merged fields, weighbridge register. - Manual attach (attachImplementsManually): hoses and PTO connected and disconnected. - autoTurnOffTurnLights: no effect while FarmPilot drives. - Mods that look for AutoDrive find FarmPilot.

text.name: fp_help_f7_2_text
text.text: All choices (implement, next field, trailer, trailer swap, implement settings) are sent to the other players and kept in the savegame.

text.name: fp_help_f7_3_text
text.text: FarmPilot_config.xml (network), FarmPilot_Autonome.xml (kept courses), FarmPilot_RemorquesBalles.xml, FarmPilot_PassagesBouches.xml. Folder modSettings/FS25_FarmPilot: exported routes, colours.

text.name: fp_help_f8_1_text
text.text: - Orange cog: validate the implement settings. - Message « implement or combination moving »: it waits until folding is done. - Autonomous mode with only a tipper: a working implement is needed. - No road to the destination: check the links in the editor.

text.name: fp_help_f8_2_text
text.text: No Courseplay course at the implement width, or several: see the Autonomous courses window.

text.name: fp_help_f8_3_title
text.text: Destination changed when loading the game

text.name: fp_help_f8_3_text
text.text: Destinations are now kept by their name. A game already shifted: choose the destination again once.

text.name: fp_help_f8_4_text
text.text: Attach the log.txt file (Documents/My Games/FarmingSimulator2025): the lines [FarmPilot …] and [AD-…] say what each driver is doing.
